Matched now, Matched since reload, packets and bytes: what pf counted for the rules of each class. Every filter reload, an Apply among them, starts them again from 0 - packets and bytes too, unless the firewall keeps counters - while connections keep their mark; and a connection two classes match is counted under both, keeping the mark of the lower sequence. Marked now, above, counts each connection pf holds with the DSCP of a class once, whenever it opened.
